answer: The defence here is SIM-based identity with carrier attestation: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 92 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One basalt of signal, one gale of cost, one terrace of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
